sourceInformation.perspective: first person on foot, at the wheel, and in story scenes
sourceInformation.tech: Pixel Engine 0.46.0, three.js r186, Rapier 0.20, esbuild 0.28.2. Original sim, fire grid, weapons, and missions.
sourceInformation.artDirection: Engine pixel-art toon at 480x270. Sand, orange, and red land. Slate for Concord, orange for the Harvest Front. Green only for water and regrowth.
sourceInformation.animation: Engine clips on the soldier rig. First-person hands on a small rig. Mixer poses for reload, the map, and surgery.
sourceInformation.audio: Code songs, code effects, and no audio files. Animalese voices. Music starts at 10 percent.
sourceInformation.online: AI Hub shared-world for 1-4 players. Cash Run lasts 6 minutes. Same-computer link uses a BroadcastChannel.
sourceInformation.testing: node tests/run.mjs --all. Headless Engine.step playthrough. Playwright Chromium with WebGPU flags. Hub harness, four scenarios.
sourceInformation.research: Mechanics from the plan, not a port. No source maps, names, or plot.

aiHub.name: A Cry Too Far
aiHub.tagline: Stones, fire, and a bad contract
aiHub.description: A first-person survival shooter in the Kettle. Two factions pay you in stones to burn a firebreak you were not meant to see. Play the story alone, or carry diamond cases in Cash Run with up to four players.
aiHub.controls: Gamepad, keyboard, and mouse. First person on foot and in vehicles.
